review.body:
Reviewed PR #21 ("Plan bounded larger complete-input review pages", riatzukiza, codex/muse-bounded-review-pages-plan → main): all 21 changed files / 35 diff pages read and individually assessed. Purely additive planning-and-admission change (+3409/−0, zero source, test, config, or workflow edits).

Deterministic evidence: summary.json exact_head/clean_checkout true, result success, no errors; diff_stat exit 0. The zero-deletion stat independently corroborates the PR's append-only and 194-unchanged-tracked-files claims.

Verified during the map/candidate sweep: all append-only ledgers grow correctly (receipts schema conformance for all 4 added events checked against required-keys/known-kinds/iso-ts); the card's incoming→accepted→breakdown→ready hops are canonical kanban-fsm states with matching write-id bindings; the parent card is untouched; all 8 source anchors cited by the design match the working tree (apply-step! persists before return, encode-result is post-handler, string pass-through exists); every numeric claim re-computed (830→413, 1660→826, 834/1660=50.24%, 16384×6=98,304, 98,365=98,304+61 envelope); admission evidence is honestly bound to head 9cbd373 rather than the current head; no secrets present.

Confirmed finding (non-blocking, low): docs/designs/bounded-full-review-pages.md:5 states the child card "is an Incoming / 3-point continuation" while this same PR sets that card to ready (frontmatter, ledger transitions, Ready3 diagnostics). The design is the one incoming-state claim in the PR with no timestamp qualifier. Correct the sentence or qualify it with the design-freeze timestamp.

Non-blocking notes: no tests added — appropriate for a planning-only PR whose design schedules tests for the implementation PR; the PR body's "implementation awaits … canonical Rheos admission" wording predates the completed admission and is stale like the design sentence (PR body is not an anchorable diff line); quoted CodeRabbit/GitHub JSON in the diagnostics was treated as untrusted evidence only; local absolute paths and quota IDs appear in diagnostics by this repo's established convention, with tokens explicitly unset.

Verdict derived by law: COMMENT (1 confirmed finding, non-blocking).

root_comment.body: docs/designs/bounded-full-review-pages.md line 5 states the child `5e08a9c7-1c1e-4072-8b44-47043d5f0218` "is an Incoming / 3-point continuation". In the same PR, docs/agile/kanban/5e08a9c7-...md ships with frontmatter `status: "ready"`, .ημ/kanban-events/ledger.edn appends the three canonical status-change events that moved the card incoming→accepted→breakdown→ready, and .ημ/diagnostics/bounded-review-pages-admission/05-read.json + 06-prefix-proof.json record post-admission state "Ready3". The design carries no "as of" timestamp, unlike the timestamped diagnostic snapshots (design-audit 17:47, receipts) that correctly show incoming at write time, so a reader of the merged design is given a status claim contradicted by the same commit's own admission ledger. Smallest corrective direction: update the design's status sentence to Ready (or qualify it with the design-freeze timestamp/head), keeping the parent-status sentence unchanged (the parent is verified untouched and still Incoming/3).

pr_body.before:
Large complete-input reviews can exhaust the fixed review budget before every page is assessed. This planning change proposes one shared paginator with larger logical pages and a49,152-byte ceiling on the entire encoded read response, including escaping and current chronology metadata. It adds a specific check before successful delivery credit and preserves all input, assessment, finding and publication requirements.

The proposed3-point Incoming child links native timeout/source research and a current-main design. Effective host-limit verification and consumer activation remain separate prerequisites; no host limit, timeout, model, coverage rule or caller pin changes here. The historical830→413-page sizing result is an analytical hypothesis, not a candidate test or a guarantee of faster completion.

Validation: root reviewed the design and current paginator/plugin seams; author audit verifies194 tracked inputs unchanged,15local links and append-only provenance prefixes; git diff --check passes.
